patthana15.37:1.1: kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no saññojano na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, no ganthaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no gantho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, no oghaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no ogho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, no yogaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no yogo na kusalo dhammo uppajjajati hetupaccayā. no nīvaraṇaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no nīvaraṇo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. no parāmāsaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no parāmāso na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
